texto: In the German formal and legal register, the **wenn** conditional conjunction may be omitted. In such a case, the conjugated verb in Konjunktiv II moves to the first absolute position of the subordinate clause (**V1-Stellung**): **Hätten die Parteien früher verhandelt, wäre der Rechtsstreit vermieden worden** (If the parties had negotiated earlier, the dispute would have been avoided).

bloques.titulo: Structure of the subsequent main clause
texto: The main sentence following the inverted condition starts with the conjugated verb or the correlative pronoun **so** immediately followed by the conjugated verb: **Wäre der Vertrag unterschrieben worden, (so) bestünde nun Rechtssicherheit**.
